translations.title: Dracula
translations.overview: Il Conte Dracula arriva in Inghilterra ed inizia ad insidiare la giovane e virtuosa Mina. La leggenda del Conte Vampiro comicia da questa pellicola del 1931, del regista Tod Browning.

A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet with the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves and drives the agent to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.
translations.tagline: The story of the strangest passion the world has ever known!
